seo.title: LOBAMBA — LUSITO KUBANTFU LABANGENALIKHAYA - No Home Help
seo.description: Tinombolo letihloliwe telusito loluphutfumako, indzawo yekuhlala, kudla, imphilo, kuphepha nemtsetfo eLobamba.

page.heading: LOBAMBA — LUSITO KUBANTFU LABANGENALIKHAYA
page.urgent: Nangabe kunengoti lephutfumako, shayela tinsita tesimo lesiphutfumako letibhalwe ngentasi. Timo tendzawo tingaphazamisa tinsita.
page.notice: Lwati, tikhatsi, imigomo netindzawo kungashintja. Shayela ungakahambi. Loluhlu alucinisekisi umbhede, kudla, imali, kwelashwa noma umsebenti.
page.intro: Cala ngensita lefanele ngentasi. Shano kutsi useLobamba, kutsi unayo yini indzawo lephephile kulobusuku, netidzingo temphilo, kuphepha, kukhubateka noma kuvikelwa kwemntfwana.
page.footer: Umthombo ukhona kulokunye nalokunye. Indzawo yekulala ayicinisekiswa.

entries.title: National emergency helplines
entries.description: National emergency helplines iniketa noma ihlele lusito lwe lusito loluphutfumako eLobamba. Tsintsana nabo kucinisekisa imigomo, indzawo nekutsi lusito luyatfolakala.
entries.phone: Police 999; ambulance 977; fire 933; women and children 951; child helpline 116
entries.how_to_access: Shayela noma ubuke iwebhusayithi lesemtsetfweni ungakahambi. Buta lusito lolukhona namuhla nemibhalo ledzingekako.

entries.title: Baphalali Eswatini Red Cross Society
entries.description: Baphalali Eswatini Red Cross Society iniketa noma ihlele lusito lwe lusito loluphutfumako eLobamba. Tsintsana nabo kucinisekisa imigomo, indzawo nekutsi lusito luyatfolakala. Call to ask which branch or response team covers Lobamba.
